messages:
sara: Heads up — canary A/B for model v2-quant started ~1h ago. Quick summary: global embedding recall seems down ~4.8% on our rouge-like eval set, latency looks fine. Need guidance on rollback thresholds. :thinking:

dan: :eyes: Can you paste the gating rules we set for canaries? I recall combined pass needs quality delta <= 3% and p95 latency <= 150ms but not 100% sure.

sara: Copy of current gate we deployed to the canary (from config):
```
{
  "canary": {
    "traffic_steps": [0.05, 0.2, 0.5],
    "quality_gate": {"metric": "recall@10", "max_relative_delta_percent": 3},
    "latency_gate": {"p95_ms": 150, "max_relative_increase_percent": 20},
    "slice_checks": ["core_queries","long_tail","zero_shot"]
  }
}
```

michael: Where did the 4.8% come from? Is that weighted by traffic? Might be a long-tail-heavy artifact.

sara: Breakdown: core_queries (80% traffic) delta +1.2%; medium queries (18%) delta +0.9%; long-tail (2% traffic) delta +18% — looks like quantized model fails on repeated-context / short prompt patterns. I can dump a few examples.

eva: If long-tail is only 2% traffic, global weighted delta masks it. We should have a safety-net: any slice delta > 10% should fail the canary even if global is OK. Also consider consecutive-window rule so flakey noise doesn't flip things.

dan: Proposed rule update: require both (a) weighted global delta <= 3% AND (b) no slice with delta > 10%. Also fail if latency p95 increases > 20%. On failure: immediate rollback to baseline and an automated incident to #oncall.

ci-bot: deploy-v2-quant: canary started -> step 5% traffic -> promoting check at 20%. Metric check FAILED: slice=long_tail recall@10 delta=18.2% > threshold(10%). Pausing rollout and notifying on-call.

sara: Ok initiating rollback now. Thanks @ci-bot. I'll open an eval PR with targeted long-tail cases (repeats + short context). :thumbsup:

michael: Also add a temporal rule: "stop if slice delta > 8% for 3 consecutive 5-min windows" so transient spikes don't get promoted.

sara: Agree. Will add to gating config before next run. New snippet to add: 
```
"slice_failure_rules": {
  "max_relative_delta_percent": 10,
  "consecutive_window_failure": {"threshold_percent": 8, "windows": 3, "window_minutes": 5}
}
```

eva: Add one more operational tweak: route a higher fraction of long-tail traffic to canary during the test (dynamic oversampling) so we see regressions earlier. Add to TODOs and postmortem checklist. :memo:

sara: Will do. Action items: 1) rollback complete, 2) add targeted evals (repeats), 3) patch gating rules (slice hard-fail + consecutive-window), 4) enable long-tail oversample for next canary. I'll tag you all on the eval PR.

dan: Sounds good. Also let's add an alert for "canary_pause" to paging rules so on-call sees it immediately.

sara: noted, will include. Thanks all.
